title: Handler · what is in memory as orders arrive

input.label: Events
input.hint: o: an order. d: an order the limiter defers. p: a priority order. t: the 2 second tick.

variables.name: len(h.deferred)
variables.meaning: orders held back by the soft rate limit

variables.name: h.nextSequence
variables.meaning: the sequence number of the last order that was stamped

outputs.name: h.batch
outputs.meaning: orders still in memory at the end

nodes.label: Submit
nodes.role: Remembers the order's ID, stamps the order and routes it.

nodes.label: enqueue
nodes.role: Appends the order to h.batch and flushes when the batch holds maxBatch orders.

edgeCases.text: The flush runs when the batch reaches 64, so the order that fills the batch is written by the same call that queued it.

nodes.label: releaseDeferred
nodes.role: Moves every deferred order to the end of the batch.

edgeCases.text: Deferred orders are appended after the orders that were queued later, so the Store does not receive orders in the order they were submitted.

nodes.label: flushLocked
nodes.role: Writes the whole batch to the Store and empties it.
